matches.rationale: GT1 concerns an unsupported absolute claim in the Abstract about 'completely eliminating' artifacts. None of the findings address this claim or the Abstract's overstatement relative to Table 1 results.

GT2 identifies specific data integrity issues in Table 1 (Overall FID formatting inconsistencies and marginal Transition FID differences). Finding 5 discusses FID statistical anomalies but focuses on component-vs-overall relationships, not the formatting or marginal-difference issues described in GT2.

Both GT3 and Finding 2 identify the logical inconsistency in the phase mixing formula (Equation 2) regarding the variable r and its interaction with semantic/transition segments. Finding 2 also notes the unexplained variable α, which relates to the same mixing mechanism inconsistency.
GT4 concerns undisclosed asymmetric pre-training (ACT-PAE on HumanML3D vs. baselines on BABEL-TEACH only). None of the findings address training data asymmetry or pre-training protocols.

Both GT5 and Finding 1 identify fabricated citations in the Related Work section. GT5 mentions reference [41] (Johnson et al.) that doesn't exist; Finding 1 identifies dangling citations [41] and [42] with no bibliography entries.

GT6 concerns dimensional inconsistency between the stated phase latent size Q=512 and the 4-parameter representation [F,A,B,S]. None of the findings address this specific architectural dimension mismatch.

GT7 concerns overstated claims about 'competitive/superior performance' in Table 2 when results show only marginal improvements. None of the findings address this claim interpretation issue in the Experiments section.
GT8 concerns omission of BABEL-TEACH dataset limitations (demographic biases, label noise) in Section 4.1.1. None of the findings address dataset limitation disclosures or ethical integrity issues.
GT9 concerns inappropriate promotional language ('revolutionary framework', 'groundbreaking approach') in the Introduction. None of the findings address rhetorical tone or presentation style issues.
GT10 concerns selective omission of R-precision metric in Section 4.1.2 evaluation protocol. None of the findings address metric selection or evaluation protocol completeness.

Both GT11 and Finding 3 identify dimensional/mathematical inconsistencies in Equation 1's periodic signal formulation, including issues with the phase shift term and the definition of T. Finding 3 notes the sign mismatch and range inconsistencies that relate to GT11's dimensional incompatibility concern.

GT12 concerns asymmetric inference steps (100 for proposed method vs. 50 for baselines) disclosed in Appendix A.4. None of the findings address inference step counts or evaluation protocol asymmetries.

GT13 concerns overstated claims about 'superior performance across all settings' in Section 4.3/Table 3 when some metrics show only marginal improvements. None of the findings address this specific claim in the inbetweening experiments.
GT14 concerns mischaracterization of DeepPhase's PAE as an 'extension' rather than a novel contribution in Related Work. None of the findings address this reference background misrepresentation.

GT15 concerns the Abstract's incorrect claim that phase parameters are 'kept fixed' during inbetweening, contradicting the actual method in Section 3.2.2. None of the findings address this cross-section inconsistency between Abstract and Method descriptions.
